resources.string: Ask for authentication when any app opens the system photo picker or file picker. This stops someone from reaching your photos and files by attaching a picture or document in another app.
Ask for authentication while the Wi-Fi / Internet, Bluetooth, mobile data, airplane mode, hotspot, NFC and location tiles are shown in Quick Settings, so they can\'t be switched without unlocking.
Needs the Accessibility detection method: the other methods can\'t see the Quick Settings panel. Change it under Detection method below.

Photo and file picker: locks the system pickers (Photo Picker, Files / DocumentsUI, Samsung My Files). After you unlock, the picker is still there and the app that opened it carries on. Backup import and export inside App Lock are never locked. A picker built into an app, such as a gallery app\'s own picker or the embedded photo picker on Android 14+, is not a system component: lock that app in the app list instead.\n\nQuick settings: Android doesn\'t let an app block a tap on another app\'s tile. While the tiles are on screen, a lock screen covers the whole panel, notifications included, until you unlock. It also covers the Settings Internet and Wi-Fi pop-up panels. Opening the full Settings app is not covered; lock the Settings app for that. It doesn\'t apply on the device lock screen, and there is no Sync tile on most devices.
